# B"H Architecture

ikar HTML → semantic fallback → critical-boot → ikar-stable.boot → ikar-first.boot
ikar-first now hydrates empty identity via /api/social/heichelos/:id and /series
series cards use /heichelos/:id/series/:seriesId (200 on local)
social styles stay imported under .awtsmoos-social-root
reader auto-scroll modules already own Start/Stop river
